units.source_text: 时值三月初十左右，天气晴朗，人意悠闲，正是风光明媚的季节。

en.t: It was around the tenth day of the third month; the weather was clear, people's spirits were relaxed, and it was just the season of bright and beautiful scenery.

units.source_text: 宫中此时恰好没有重大的节会，大家很空闲，每日只是以竞相搜集欣赏书画为消遣。

en.t: At this time there happened to be no major festivals or ceremonies at court, so everyone had plenty of leisure and spent each day amusing themselves by competing to collect and admire calligraphy and paintings.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣想道：“同样竞赛，何不扩大规模，让陛下多欣赏些？”

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji thought, "If we are going to compete, why not make it grander and let His Majesty enjoy more of them?"

units.source_text: 便特别用心搜集佳作，尽数送入梅壶女御宫中。

en.t: So he took special care in gathering fine works and sent them all into the apartments of the Umetsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 于是两女御都有了各式各样的许多画。

en.t: As a result, both consorts came to possess many paintings of all kinds.

units.source_text: 故事画内容最为丰富，构图最吸引人，所以梅壶女御选的尽是古代故事的名画杰作。

en.t: Story paintings had the richest content and the most engaging compositions, so the Umetsubo Consort chose only famous masterpieces depicting ancient tales.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御所选绘的，都是当世珍奇情景及趣味丰富之题材。

en.t: The paintings selected and commissioned by the Kokiden Consort all portrayed rare scenes of the present age and subjects full of interest.

units.source_text: 讲到表面的新颖与华丽，则弘徽殿较胜一筹。

en.t: When it came to outward novelty and splendor, Kokiden had the advantage.

units.source_text: 此时皇上左右诸宫女，凡具有修养者，每日品短评长，以绘画鉴赏为事。

en.t: At this time, among the ladies serving around the emperor, all those with cultivation spent their days comparing and critiquing the works, making the appreciation of paintings their occupation.
